scope: AAPL consolidated FY2026–FY2030 manual forecast; ordinal annual periods after the selected fiscal end, using later-filed information. Financial scope/rationale and information cutoff must be supplied and reviewed.
limitations: All 37 numerical assumptions and analyst identity/date/rationale are unset; no defaults or historical calibration.
Revenue-only retained historical binding; no forecast, WACC, terminal, asset/claim, class-equivalence or award inputs approved.
Manual margins include SBC and operating-lease service costs. Expense D&A, financed investment and WC scope require issuer-specific semantic review; historical proxies remain incomplete.
Historical cash movements are not automatic forecast WC inputs. Gross financial assets are not automatically eligible assets; historical omissions do not approve valuation omissions.
Fiscal-end analytical date using later-filed information; no contemporaneous backtest or established information cutoff.
Anchor fiscal year is September 29, 2024–September 27, 2025; FY2026–FY2030 are ordinal fiscal labels, not assumed December year-ends. No automatic 52/53-week adjustment.
